title: Florida House, District 78
what_it_does: Represents District 78 (Part of Lee) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Susan Frantz
candidates.occupation: Founder and CEO of Frantz Marketing Solutions
candidates.background: Susan Frantz was raised in Lee County and founded Frantz Marketing Solutions, a Fort Myers marketing and public-affairs firm she has run for more than 15 years. She serves on the boards of Our Mother's Home, cancer-support organizations and SWFL Inc., and on an advisory board at FGCU's business college. She entered the race in May 2026 after the incumbent was appointed Lee County Supervisor of Elections.

candidates.name: Cindy Banyai
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Teacher, small business owner and nonprofit leader; Ph.D. in community development
candidates.background: Cindy Banyai holds a master's and Ph.D. from Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University in Japan and has worked for about 20 years in community development, evaluation and nonprofit leadership in Southwest Florida and abroad. She teaches college courses, runs a consulting business, and was the Democratic nominee for Congress in Florida's 19th District in 2020 and 2022. She lives in Fort Myers with her three children.
